rules.statement: Don't report a convention violation on a line that a mechanical bulk edit (such as renumbering or renaming references) only rewrote, when the violation was already there before the edit and fixing it is a separate cross-cutting change.
rules.why: The maintainer declined every such finding: the violating text predates the pull request, the edit only rewrote one token on the line, and moving it is its own change across many files that is tracked separately.
rules.check: Before reporting, compare the old and new versions of the changed line. If the only difference is the mechanical substitution (for example `ADR-0NNN` changed to `ADR-1NNN`) and the violation, such as an internal citation in `///` text, was there before, don't raise it in this pull request.
